summary: @servicetitan/eslint-plugin-mobx-6 preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: The npm package's preinstall hook runs setup.mjs, which downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases (architecture-selected zip), extracts it, chmods the binary to 0755, and then executes a bundled 727KB file math_init.js under that Bun runtime via execFileSync. math_init.js is an opaque `// @bun @bun-cjs` compiled bundle with rotating string/number array obfuscation (rotator function over a large numeric/string array, hex-named identifiers) and is not human-readable. setup.mjs itself uses hex-name identifier and string-literal obfuscation. The package presents itself as an ESLint plugin for MobX 6, a role that has no legitimate need to fetch a second JavaScript runtime at install time or to execute an opaque compiled bundle. The install-time delivery of an alternate runtime specifically to run an obfuscated payload evades Node-focused install-time scanners, and the payload's behavior on the installer host cannot be determined from the shipped source.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
